metadata.dataset: Big National Banks — High-Yield & Hybrid Savings Accounts (HYSA)

accounts.signup_bonus_terms: New Barclays Savings/CD customers: open by 2026-10-31, deposit >=$25,000 within 30 days, maintain >=$25,000 for 120 consecutive days; paid ~60 days after completion.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited monthly withdrawals and ACH transfers; 5-business-day hold on check/electronic deposits (interest accrues upon posting); zero-balance accounts close after 6 months.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Barclays US App (iOS & Android); 24/7 encrypted access, multi-factor authentication, biometric login, Remote Deposit check capture.
accounts.flag_notes: None — all values confirmed on official page as of 2026-10-07.

accounts.fee_waiver_rules: No monthly fees or minimum balance requirements
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No active public cash sign-up bonus advertised on official product page.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited electronic transfers and ATM withdrawals; optional ATM card (Plus/Accel logos) with up to $5/cycle domestic ATM fee refund (unlimited for Perks Diamond); $25 outgoing wire fee; $2,000/day mobile check deposit limit.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Synchrony Bank Mobile App (4.8/5 Apple App Store, 4.6/5 Google Play Store as of 2026-09-01); 24/7 fraud monitoring, custom alerts, biometric login.
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Max Balance Unverified & Widget Discrepancy)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Max balance cap is not disclosed on public product page (left blank, unverified). 2) Embedded savings calculator widget on page displays stale '2.85%' while page headline and CTA state '3.55% APY' accurate as of 10/21/2026.

accounts.fee_waiver_rules: No monthly fees or minimum deposit required
accounts.max_balance_limit: $1,000,000 per account ($3,000,000 aggregate across all Marcus accounts)
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: Marcus Refer-a-Friend: +1.00% promotional APY increase on top of 3.50% APY (= 4.50% APY) for 3 months per referral (combined 1-year APY of 3.75% with 1 referral; up to 5 referrals/year).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited withdrawals; same-day ACH transfers up to $100,000 when initiated by 12:00 pm ET on a business day; incoming transfers earn interest the day request is received; account may close if unfunded or $0 balance for 60 days.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Marcus by Goldman Sachs App (iOS & Android); Ranked #1 in Customer Satisfaction with HYSAs from Online-Only Banks by J.D. Power (2026); 24/7 U.S. contact center, MFA.
accounts.flag_notes: None — all terms verified via Marcus product page (2026-10-21) and Deposit Account Agreement.

accounts.min_balance_for_apy: $25,000+ Combined Qualifying Balance (CQB) + Eligible Companion Account
accounts.fee_waiver_rules: Waived when holding U.S. Bank Smartly Checking, Safe Debit account, U.S. Bank Smartly Visa Signature Card, or minor owner under age 18.
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: Standard rate is 0.05% APY. Pairing with Smartly Checking, Safe Debit, or Smartly Visa Signature Card unlocks relationship APY: <$5k CQB = 1.00% APY; $5k–$24,999.99 CQB = 2.00% APY; $25,000+ CQB = 3.50% APY.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: $0 ATM transaction fees at U.S. Bank ATMs; $0 overdraft protection transfer fees; new-account rate sheet excludes customers who held or closed a U.S. Bank savings/MMA within past 90 days.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: U.S. Bank Mobile App (Ranked #1 overall in mobile banking); full nationwide branch and ATM access, biometric security.
accounts.nyc_availability: Available Online (Rates vary by ZIP code; verified for ZIP 55402)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Max Balance Unverified & Live Calculator Service Warning)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Max balance cap not disclosed on public rate sheet (left blank, unverified). 2) Interactive calculator widget on page displays 'We're temporarily having trouble displaying our current rates', though static HTML rate table confirms 0.05% standard / 3.50% relationship APY as of October 21, 2026.

accounts.account_name: U.S. Bank Elite Money Market Account
accounts.min_balance_for_apy: $25,000 deposited within 30 days and maintained daily
accounts.fee_waiver_rules: Waived with $10,000 minimum daily balance or U.S. Bank Smartly Checking account (or Gold+ tier).
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: 3.40% APY (3.34% interest rate) applies only to new Elite Money Market clients (no existing U.S. Bank savings/MMA) who deposit >=$25,000 within 30 days and maintain >=$25,000 daily. Otherwise standard rate is 0.01% (<$25k) / 0.05% ($25k+).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Includes ATM card, debit card, and check-writing privileges; fees reduce eligible daily balance if balance is near $25,000 threshold.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: U.S. Bank Mobile App (#1 ranked mobile app); full branch and ATM access.
accounts.nyc_availability: Available Online (Rates vary by ZIP code; verified for ZIP 55402)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Max Balance Unverified & Existing Client Rate Drop)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Max balance cap not disclosed on public page (left blank). 2) Existing clients open >=30 days who did not qualify for new-money tier earn 0.01%–0.05% standard APY.

accounts.account_name: Wells Fargo Platinum Savings (New Customer Offer)
accounts.min_balance_for_apy: $25,000 deposited within 30 days and maintained daily
accounts.fee_waiver_rules: Waived with $3,500 minimum daily balance each fee period.
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: Online new savings customers earn 3.25% APY (3.20% interest rate) on >=$25,000 (excludes CO). Separate banker-enrolled offer provides 3.50% APY for 12 months with $10,000+ new money (4.00% APY in Cook, DuPage, Lake counties, IL).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Includes check-writing option and ATM access; if collected balance drops below $25,000 on any day, reverts to Standard (0.01% APY) or Relationship (0.02%–0.05% APY) rate.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Wells Fargo Mobile® App (iOS & Android); 24/7 fraud monitoring, biometric login, nationwide branch/ATM network.
accounts.nyc_availability: Available Nationwide (excluding CO for 3.25% APY new customer offer)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Max Balance Unverified & Regional Rate Variance)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Max balance cap not disclosed on public rate page (left blank). 2) Without ZIP cookie, /savings-cds/platinum/ displays 'Rates are unavailable at this time'. 3) Cook, DuPage, and Lake counties (IL) receive 4.00% APY vs 0.01%/3.25% elsewhere.

accounts.account_name: American Express® High Yield Savings Account
accounts.fee_waiver_rules: No monthly fees or minimum balance requirements
accounts.max_balance_limit: $5,000,000 per account (max 20 open accounts per customer)
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: New HYSA customers who hold a consumer American Express Platinum Card® qualify for an 'Exclusive Savings Rate' higher than standard 3.20% APY; exact spread varies and is disclosed only inside authenticated statement.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Must be funded within 60 days to remain open; no ATM/debit card or checks; express same-day ACH transfers supported; pulled ACH deposits earn interest immediately.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: American Express® App (iOS & Android); unified card + bank dashboard, 24/7 customer support, mobile check deposit, biometric & 2FA security.
accounts.flag_notes: Standard 3.20% APY and $5M max balance verified. Exact APY of the Exclusive Savings Rate for Platinum Card holders is not published in public PDF terms (left unverified).

accounts.account_name: 360 Performance Savings (and Migrating Discover Online Savings)
accounts.compounding_frequency: Accrued daily, compounded and credited monthly
accounts.fee_waiver_rules: No monthly service charge or minimum balance
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No active public cash bonus on 360 Performance Savings as of 2026-10-21. Companion 360 Checking offers $250 bonus via code CHECKING250 (2x $500+ direct deposits in 75 days) or DEBIT250/STUDENT250 (20x $10+ debit transactions in 75 days).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited electronic transfers; non-cash deposits accrue interest no later than next business day; Discover Online Savings & Money Market accounts are migrating into 360 Performance Savings.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Capital One Mobile App (iOS & Android); CreditWise free credit & dark web monitoring, 70,000+ fee-free ATMs, Capital One Cafés & Branches.
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (SSR 'NaN APY' Bug & Discover Charter Merger)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) 3.20% APY verified on apply.capitalone.com/fc/index.html (effective 10/21/2026), whereas capitalone.com/bank/savings-accounts/online-performance-savings-account/ and discover.com/online-banking/savings-account/ render 'NaN APY' in server-side HTML. 2) Capital One and Discover share FDIC Cert #4297 since 2025-11-18. 3) Max balance cap not disclosed in public disclosure (left blank).

accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No bonus on flat-rate Online Savings; new customers should open Barclays Tiered Savings instead to earn 3.50%–3.65% APY + $200 bonus.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited monthly withdrawals/transfers; 5-business-day hold on check/electronic deposits.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Barclays US App (iOS & Android); 24/7 online access, Remote Deposit check capture.
accounts.flag_notes: Strictly dominated by Barclays Tiered Savings (which pays 3.50%–3.65% APY plus $200 bonus under the same FDIC Cert #57203).

accounts.compounding_frequency: Accrued daily, compounded monthly, credited monthly
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No public sign-up bonus advertised for PNC High Yield Savings.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited deposits; up to 6 free withdrawals/transfers per month recommended per savings disclosures.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: PNC Mobile Banking App (iOS & Android); Auto Savings, Low Cash Mode®, biometric login.
accounts.nyc_availability: NOT Available in NYC (Geo-Restricted to Out-of-Branch Markets)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Geo-Blocked in NYC & Max Balance Unverified)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Page title/metadata confirms 3.15% APY, but page body displays 'This Product Isn't Available in Your Area' when accessed from New York City (in-branch footprint). 2) Max balance cap not disclosed in public fee schedule (left blank).

accounts.fee_waiver_rules: No monthly maintenance fees, overdraft fees, ACH fees, or incoming wire fees
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No active public sign-up bonus; includes built-in Savings Buckets and Boosters (Round Ups, Surprise Savings, Recurring Transfers).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Limit of 10 withdrawals and transfers per statement cycle (no fee for exceeding, but account closed if exceeded on more than an occasional basis).
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Ally Mobile App (iOS & Android); Awarded 'Best Online Bank of 2026', Savings Buckets & Boosters, 2FA, biometric login.
accounts.flag_notes: 3.10% APY verified as of 10/21/2026. Max balance limit is not specified on public rate page (left blank).

accounts.signup_bonus_terms: No cash bonus on Alto Online Savings (Retail BMO Savings Builder offers $5/mo reward up to $60/yr but pays only 0.01% APY).
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Unlimited ACH transfers and withdrawals; must fund within 90 days or closed if $0 balance for 90 consecutive days; NO checks, debit cards, wire transfers, or Zelle® supported.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: BMO Alto Online & Mobile platform; FDIC insured under BMO Bank N.A. (Cert #16571).
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Brand Transition, Shared FDIC Charter & Calculator Blank)
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Official banner notes brand transition from 'BMO Alto' to 'Alto'. 2) Shares $250k FDIC limit with retail BMO Bank N.A. accounts. 3) Modal calculator text has unpopulated '% Annual Percentage Yield (APY)' string, though hero confirms 3.00% APY as of October 21, 2026. 4) Max balance limit not stated on product page (left blank).

accounts.fee_waiver_rules: Waived with $500+ Average Monthly Balance, linked Citi checking account, or Citi Priority ($30k+), Citigold ($200k+), or Citigold Private Client ($1M+) Relationship Tier.
accounts.signup_bonus_amount: Ineligible for Citi Savings Promo Rate
accounts.signup_bonus_terms: Citi Accelerate Savings is explicitly excluded from New Citi Savings Promotional Rate offers per Consumer Deposit Account Agreement.
accounts.withdrawal_rules: Access to 65,000+ fee-free ATMs, mobile check deposit, real-time transfers; zero balance for 90 days subject to closure.
accounts.digital_app_and_security: Citi Mobile® App (iOS & Android); biometric authentication, 65,000+ fee-free ATMs.
accounts.nyc_availability: NOT Available in NYC (Restricted to National Rate Region + TX; excludes NY, NJ, CT, CA, FL, IL, MD, VA, DC, NV)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (APY Unverified / Geo-Gated Template Token)
accounts.flag_notes: CRITICAL FLAG: Official Citi page renders literal uninterpolated placeholder ':BLUE_AccSavings_Rate%' on citi.com/banking/savings-account and '% · % · %' on citi.com/banking/compare-bank-accounts when accessed from NYC because New York residential addresses are excluded from the National Rate Region. Per strict verification policy, APY is left blank rather than inferred.
